Image uploads (Cloudflare R2)

When enabled, images inserted into the shared images folder upload to R2 and are referenced by their public URL instead of being copied into this site's own files.

Needs the scheme (starts with "https://" or "http://") - this is fetched directly by a browser, not passed through the site. If you save without one, "https://" is added for you.

Resize image

Shrinks the actual image file on disk and overwrites it. This can't be undone, and the image can't be made bigger again afterward.

Insert image from a web link

Links to the image where it already lives - nothing is downloaded or stored in this site. If that page ever goes away, the image stops showing here too.
